parameters.command:
F=/host/quant-dashboard-data/dashboard.json
if [ ! -f "$F" ]; then
  printf 'dashboard_meta: {"path": "%s", "readable": false, "bytes": null, "sha256": null}\n' "$F"
  exit 0
fi
printf 'dashboard_meta: {"path": "%s", "readable": true, "bytes": %s, "sha256": "%s"}\n' \
  "$F" "$(wc -c <"$F" | tr -d ' ')" "$(sha256sum "$F" | cut -d' ' -f1)"
cat "$F"

parameters.content: ## CURRENT LIFECYCLE — one routed stage\nBuild lifecycle view derives a display-only view from the assembled snapshot. Current Stage Router sends each refresh to exactly one lifecycle indicator (or Attention / Unresolved). Green here means the routed presentation received data; it never launches, retries, resumes, promotes, or mutates runtime state.

## SOURCE / METRICS REFRESH — read-only observation\nEvery source node reads host state read-only (cat/ls/wc/sha256sum). Green execution here means only source read succeeded; it is not lifecycle activity.\nNo pipeline, Kanban, candidate, leaderboard, results-root or GitHub state is written. The only write is the snapshot file in the n8n deployment shadow dir.
